observations.behavior: Adds a new module, posthog/kafka_client/dlq_replay.py, with a drain_dlq command, helper functions, and tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a Kafka consumer group ID and a replay-count guard to messages replayed from a DLQ back to a target topic; this could help recover messages that failed ingestion and were moved to a DLQ, while preventing infinite replay loops.
